title: A single-line shift block shows three text lines: customer name, unit number, and the line name
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on a desktop browser.
  2. A single-line shift exists on the grid (VIN toggle off).
  3. You are on the Schedule page in week view.
custom_steps: 1. Read the shift block's text lines from top to bottom.
custom_expected:
1. Line 1: the customer name.
  2. Line 2: the unit number.
  3. Last line: the name of the scheduled line.
  4. No work order number appears on the block.
